entities.summary: The Second Ciolacu Cabinet was the 134th government of Romania, from 23 December 2024 to 23 June 2025. The government was led by Marcel Ciolacu who was the leader of the Social Democratic Party (PSD) until his resignation in 2025 and the withdrawal of support for the government by his party. Cătălin Predoiu was appointed to lead the government in acting capacity on 6 May.
